why:
`set_goal_callback` plus an explicit `void* ctx` handed back to the callback. Ours-only because it is the freestanding replacement for a capturing lambda: rclcpp_action takes a `std::function`, which owns its captures on the heap. The `_with_ctx` suffix is the same convention every callback-taking entity on this surface uses.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
